title: acp/1 message envelope
description: Describes the JSON that agent-comms/src/acp/models.py:Envelope actually produces via Envelope.dump() / model_dump(by_alias=True), and accepts on the way in. This has been reconciled with docs/agent-communication-protocol.md ('Core model and envelope'): the mismatches recorded in docs/decisions.md (2026-09-29, 'M1.1 schema/implementation reconciliation') were resolved in the 2026-09-29 'M1.1 schema/implementation resolutions' follow-up entry, and this file reflects the resolved shape, not the pre-resolution divergences. HandRaise (a separate, still-open gap) is not part of this file; see hand-raise.v1.json.

message_id.description: Defaults to a bare uuid4 hex. The separate, non-acp/1 handoff_compat.py legacy shim uses a different id shape ("msg-<run>-<seq>-<rand>"); that shim is intentionally out of scope for this schema.

to.description: Always a non-empty array on the wire. Envelope also accepts a bare string on input (coerced to a one-element list before validation), matching the doc's 'a single string is also accepted' -- but the wire/serialized shape (what this schema validates) is always the array form.

visibility.description: Closed enum per the doc's 'Floor control' section. `all` = visible to the whole room/transcript (Conversation.transcript() filters on exactly this value); `recipients` and `moderator` are accepted and stored but not yet enforced anywhere (no code hides a `recipients`- or `moderator`-visibility message from anyone but the intended reader) -- see docs/work-plan.md M2.5 for the deferred enforcement work.

kind.description: Constrained by Envelope's `_kind_ok` field validator (code, not the JSON type system): one of acp.models.Kind's values, or any string starting with "x-" (a namespaced extension, per the doc's 'Message kinds' section).

refs.description: Open key-value map, e.g. {"base_commit": "...", "output_commit": "...", "task_version": "..."} -- domains add keys without changing the protocol, per the doc. (The separate, non-acp/1 handoff_compat.py legacy shim has its own refs object with the same spirit but is not required to share this exact key set.)

body_format.description: Free text (e.g. "markdown", "text"); not constrained to a closed enum.
